name: Unlink External Provider
summary: The authenticated user selects an existing Microsoft association as the representative provider permutation and explicitly removes it from the current durable identity while remaining signed in as the same user.

preconditions.expression: the current durable user is authenticated and Microsoft is linked to that same user

serverInteraction.intent: Remove only the selected external provider association from the current durable identity and keep the current durable session intact.

postconditions.expression: the selected provider association is absent and the same durable user remains authenticated

sourceReferences.note: RemoveExternalLoginAsync authorizes only self-removal and records OAuthRemoveUserLogin.

External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
